hero.body: Japanese discipline in dialogue with Mediterranean produce and Peruvian heritage. Nikkei cuisine, every day from 1 pm to midnight.
stop.nikkei.title: Japan, Peru and the Mediterranean at one table
stop.nikkei.body: Nikkei cuisine is born from the meeting of Japanese precision and the liveliness of Peruvian cooking. At Nami we add the produce of the sea and of Barcelona's market.
stop.nikkei.team: Our team travels to Japan regularly to select produce and learn from the masters.
stop.pricing.title: You know what it costs before you sit down
stop.pricing.body: Two menus designed to be shared by two people, with the price in view from the start.
stop.produce.title: Raw fish, with total peace of mind
stop.produce.body: The salmon and tuna we serve are 100% anisakis-free, with no antibiotics or hormones. And all the soy that reaches the table is gluten free.
stop.produce.stat1.label: Anisakis-free salmon and tuna
stop.produce.stat2.label: All the soy we serve in the dining room
stop.shari.title: The rice that changes everything
stop.shari.body: Koshihikari rice, known for its aroma, dressed with red rice vinegar from a Japanese house founded in 1937. The result has a texture, flavour and colour of its own.
stop.shari.yearNote: Year the house behind our red rice vinegar was founded
stop.howItWorks.title: Your table, in three steps
stop.howItWorks.step1Body: Choose the day, time and number of guests.
stop.howItWorks.step2Body: We open every day from 1 pm to midnight. The kitchen serves until 11 pm.
stop.howItWorks.step3Body: À la carte or with a set-menu experience for two, with pairing if you fancy.

faq.title: Before you visit
faq.reachUs: Still have a question? Call us at
faq.items.what-is-nami.a: Nami is a Nikkei-cuisine restaurant at Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona, between Gran Via and Passeig de Gràcia. Japanese technique meets Mediterranean produce and Peruvian heritage.
faq.items.what-is-nikkei.a: It is the cuisine born of the meeting between Japan and Peru. At Nami we bring together Japanese technique and Peruvian heritage with the produce of the sea and of the Mediterranean market.
faq.items.cost.q: How much does dinner at Nami cost?
faq.items.cost.a: You can order à la carte or choose an experience for two: Short Experience for €150 (€75 per person) or Full Experience, 11 courses, for €250 (€125 per person). The wine pairing adds €100 for two.
faq.items.raw-fish-safety.q: Is it safe to eat raw fish?
faq.items.raw-fish-safety.a: The salmon and tuna we serve are 100% anisakis-free, with no antibiotics or hormones.
faq.items.gluten-free.a: All the soy we serve in the dining room is gluten free. If you have any allergy or intolerance, call us at +34 931 27 08 15 before you come.
faq.items.gluten-free.pending: Validate the allergy wording with the restaurant.
faq.items.opening-hours.a: We open Monday to Sunday, from 1 pm to midnight. The kitchen serves until 11 pm.
faq.items.location.a: At Passeig de Gràcia 24, 08008 Barcelona, a stone's throw from Casa Milà. Book online or call +34 931 27 08 15.
faq.items.groups-events.q: Do you host groups or private events?
faq.items.groups-events.a: Yes. Email us at hola@namicrestaurant.com and we will arrange it with you.
faq.items.gift-voucher.a: Yes. We sell digital vouchers for the Short and the Full Experience, valid for 12 months and with no fixed date. The code arrives by email right away. The purchase is final and non-refundable.
gift.title: The best gift is a table
gift.body: A digital voucher to enjoy the Short or the Full Experience. Valid for 12 months, no fixed date, and it lands in your inbox right away.
